topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I keep going over the meeting in my mind, the way I stepped into the new department, the smiles that seemed a little too wide. I should have noticed the tension in the air, or perhaps I did and just didn't want to see it. Now, I find myself wondering about everyone left behind, how they're coping with the change. I gave a tour, pointed out the coffee machine with a bit too much enthusiasm, maybe. Every laugh I shared felt hollow, like a cover for the unease I couldn’t quite shake. I hope they’re doing well, those I left, and that I didn’t stir more than ripples when I moved.
